title: Unit 5 — GP-05: From Sensor File to Engineering Summary
description: Follow the guided code-along to write read_creep_data.m, which reads a real USGS creepmeter file into a validated structure, then use that structure in the main script to report the record count, the slip extremes and where they occur, and the largest day-to-day change versus the net change — finishing with a printed summary and a written report file.
note: parkfield_xpk2_daily_excerpt.txt is the final 40 daily records from the USGS archive for Parkfield creepmeter station XPK2, frozen so every student has identical input. It records past surface-fault slip and must not be presented as an earthquake forecast. Run Tests and the public check never submit anything to Canvas; Download All (.zip) leaves out U05_GP05_FaultCreep_PublicCheck.m.
